tools.title: PS4 PS Patch System loader
tools.compatibility: PS4 ELF engine. Project-confirmed firmware range 9.00–12.52; requires a compatible elfldr listening on 9021. The ELF is not a BIN payload.
tools.preparation: Start the compatible PS4 elfldr and explicitly send the Orbis ELF to port 9021. Then open the patch manager on console port 23900; use /data/user/patches/xml_orbis for CUSA XML files.

tools.title: PS5 PS Patch System loader
tools.compatibility: PS5 ELF engine. Project-confirmed firmware range 3.00–12.70; requires a compatible elfldr on 9021. This does not establish support for 13.xx.
tools.preparation: Load the Prospero ELF through your compatible PS5 ELF loader, then open the patch manager on port 23900. CUSA XMLs use /data/user/patches/xml_orbis; native PPSA XMLs use /data/user/patches/xml_prospero.

tools.title: PS4 Cheats Manager 1.2.2
tools.compatibility: PS4 console PKG for managing cheats, patches and plugins. Install in your existing compatible homebrew environment; patch application additionally needs the matching GoldHEN plugin engine.
tools.preparation: Install the PKG with your supported PS4 package installer. Open PS4 Cheats Manager to enable only the patch matching your exact title ID and game update, then fully restart the game.

tools.title: GoldHEN Plugins 1.188 original ZIP
tools.compatibility: PS4 GoldHEN 2.3 or newer on a firmware supported by that GoldHEN release. Original plugin release archive; extract it before selecting a PRX.
tools.preparation: The selected game_patch.prx is also provided directly. Preserve existing plugins.ini entries; configure the game-patch plugin for your title ID instead of loading every plugin.
